entity: Team to Advance Research for Gas Energy Transformation
role: Research program sponsor for fuel cell development
stance_basis: mentioned as sponsor of fuel cell R&D program without expressing a position on Operation Breakthrough
summary: The Team to Advance Research for Gas Energy Transformation (TARGET) is referenced in the Federal Power Commission's comment letter as the sponsor of a nine-year R&D program that installed an experimental prototype total energy fuel cell in a single-family dwelling in Farmington, Connecticut. The organization is cited as context for promising fuel cell technology relevant to Operation Breakthrough's advanced utility systems demonstration, but TARGET itself does not express a position on the project. HUD's response letter acknowledges awareness of the TARGET/Pratt and Whitney fuel cell program but notes that Pratt and Whitney has not suggested using the fuel cell at this stage of development.
complaint_summary: TARGET is described as the sponsor of a nine-year R&D program that installed an experimental prototype total energy fuel cell in a single-family dwelling in Farmington, Connecticut, with 31 additional installations planned, cited as evidence of promising fuel cell technology relevant to Operation Breakthrough.
summary_quote: an experimental prototype total energy fuel cell installation was made in a single family dwelling in Farmington, Connecticut, as part of a nine-year research and development program conducted under the auspices of the Team to Advance Research for Gas Energy Transformation.
